label: sec:parity-classification-discrepancy-partition-sum-proton-preamble
html: On the three-strand Hecke algebra H_3(q), the Frobenius Casimir element and the inverse quantum dimensions \dim_q(V_\lambda)^{-1} across the three partitions \lambda \in \{(3), (2,1), (1^3)\} define canonical rational invariants of the three-quark baryon sector. This section computes the exact Markov trace of the H_3(q) Frobenius Casimir, compares the m_e-scaled inverse-dimension sums against the proton mass tower residual, evaluates the neutron–proton mass splitting at the canonical Markov parameter z = q_0^3/(q_0^2+1), and proves the pair-graph regime trichotomy governing regime switching across the isotope table.
